content.text: Photorealistic 2x2 grid portrait of the same woman using the exact face and hair from the reference image. All frames share identical lighting, background and styling. She is crouching in every frame, emphasizing a slim waist and long legs. Frame 1 full crouch pose, frame 2 crouched with hand near lips, frame 3 leaning forward close-up with intense gaze, frame 4 side angle highlighting body lines. Soft lighting, shallow depth, cohesive high-fashion mood.
